desc: ʻEua National Park is a national park on the island of ʻEua in Tonga. It is the country's only national forest park and covers an area of 4.51 km². The park is located on the east coast of the island and covers an 800 metres band of tropical rainforest and is bordered on the west by sheer cliffs to the ocean, which have numerous caves and chasms.
fact: It is the country's only national forest park and covers an area of 4.51 km² · It received national park status in 1992 · The park is located on the east coast of the island and covers an 800 metres band of tropical rainforest and is bordered on the west by sheer cliffs to the ocean, which have numerous caves and chasms · The area is protected by IUCN

desc: Adam's Bridge Marine National Park is a national park surrounding Adam's Bridge in northern Sri Lanka, approximately 30 km north west of Mannar.
